'''Sly Moore''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] [[Force Adept]] who was employed by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] as his [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Senior Administrative Aide]] during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In secret, Moore was also an acolyte of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], trained in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by Palpatine, who was in truth the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Sidious.

Following Sidious' [[Declaration of a New Order]], Moore became one of the first members of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] and gained the sobriquet "Queen of the Empire" from the [[holomedia]], with rumors spreading that she and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|the Emperor]] shared a relationship. She oversaw a series of experiments on [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] studying the spontaneous generation of life, which produced the future [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Trioculus]]. Moore disappeared shortly into the Empire's reign, and was rumored to have [[Death/Legends|died]] in seclusion in the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]] after giving birth to Palpatine's biological son [[Triclops]].

==Biography==
===Kidnapped===
Hailing from the shadowy [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] in the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]], Sly Moore was born [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. However she was not inducted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], for she was abducted from Umbara by a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] named [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and imprisoned for [[Standard month/Legends|months]] in an ancient tomb somewhere in the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]]. While imprisoned, she was mentally and spiritually assaulted by long-dead [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] on a daily basis and only her natural strength of will kept her from going completely insane. After surviving such rigorous trials, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] rescued the girl from the tomb and nursed her back to health.<ref name="TCWCG" />

Known to the Umbaran girl as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Palpatine from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], Sidious cared for the girl and educated her in [[Politics/Legends|politics]], forming a close bond over the years. The trust between Moore and Sidious was so strong, the Sith Lord revealed his own Force-sensitivity and his true identity as a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Over time, Sidious let Moore in on the Sith [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]] to bring peace to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and topple the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TCWCG" /> Vowing eternal loyalty, Moore went on to become one of Senator Palpatine's most trusted [[Aide/Legends|aides]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and followed him from his days as Senator to the time he was [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|elected]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> 

Moore's prominence in galactic politics earned her such admiration on her homeworld that she inspired other Umbarans to venture out into the galaxy. Many followed her to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and soon Umbarans became a common sight on the planet.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>

===The Chancellor's advisor===
[[File:SlyMoore-WOSW.png|thumb|left|200px|Sly Moore]]
Following the [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], Moore was rumored to have blackmailed Valorum's [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Staff Aide]] [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]] into resigning so that she herself could take the position as Palpatine ascended to the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|slymoore|Moore, Sly}}</ref> As the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] threatened to tear the Republic apart, Moore retained her position as administrative aide, standing atop the [[Chancellor's Podium/Legends|Chancellor's Podium]] opposite [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chancellor]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] during sessions of the Galactic Senate.<ref name="AOTC" />

With the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Moore continued to serve her master. Sidious even made use of the natural mind-clouding abilities of her species by having her impersonate his alter-ego Darth Sidious to force disloyal pawns into line.<ref name="JT">''[[Jedi Trial]]''</ref><ref name="Barely Tolerable3" /> As the war dragged on, Sly Moore came under scrutiny by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]; the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] leadership correctly suspected that the mysterious Darth Sidious had infiltrated the highest levels of the government.<ref name="LOE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> Before the High Council could complete the investigation, however, Chancellor Palpatine [[Order 66/Legends|eradicated]] the Order and transformed the Republic into the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Attending the [[Declaration of a New Order]], Moore bore witness to the end of democracy all the while maintaining her ties with the newly-proclaimed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

===Under the Empire===
Moore was appointed one of the first members of Palpatine's [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]]. [[Gossipvid]]s and tabloid news spread scurrilous rumors that she and Emperor Palpatine had a relationship, noting the case of other Imperial concubines like [[Roganda Ismaren/Legends|Roganda Ismaren]]. ''[[Galactic Gossip]]'' bestowed upon Moore the sobriquet of "Queen of the Empire", and she became a popular, glamorized figure even as her public appearances became rarer and rarer.<ref name="Barely Tolerable3" />

Moore was transferred to the secret planet [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] to oversee the culling and training of captured [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] and [[Jedi Service Corps/Legends|Jedi Service Corps]] members. [[Torture/Legends|Torturing]] the captives and pitting them against one another, Moore and [[Sarcev Quest]] attempted to convert the acolytes of the Jedi Order into slaves of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="ROF">''[[Reversal of Fortune]]''</ref><ref name="Barely Tolerable3" /> Moore thrived during the first year of the Empire, developing a cold rivalry with the jealous [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]] [[Malorum]] as he climbed through the ranks of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]]; Malorum often wondered why lesser beings attained the ranks he desired, pondering on Moore's presence.<ref name="DON">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]''</ref> 

As the New Order becomes increasingly biased toward Humans, Moore vanished from the Emperor's side and moved into more shadowy roles within his government. From deep within the intelligence apparatus, she and other Umbarans played a key role in identifying individuals whose loyalty to the Emperor was in question.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue" />

Moore also supervised a pair of [[Shi'ido]] scientists, [[Mammon Hoole]] and [[Borborygmus Gog]], as they conducted experiments in abiogenesis — the spontaneous generation of life. To that end, Moore provided them with a female [[Bordal]]i [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Niobi]] as a test subject. The result was [[Trioculus]], a three-eyed [[mutant]] [[Human/Legends|human]]. Sly Moore made a great impression on the young Trioculus, and though he was banished to the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|spice mines]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] by Sarcev Quest, he never forgot the "Queen of the Empire".

However, Moore herself had also come into the possession of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] DNA from an undisclosed source and was deeply interested in a technique once perfected by Sidious' former master [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]: influencing the [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] to create a zygote in a fertile female. Moore abruptly disappeared from the [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]] shortly after a [[New Year Fete Week/Legends|New Year Fete Week]] celebration, where whispers spread of her "delicate" condition. Rumors persisted that Moore had impregnated ''herself'' with the DNA and retired to her native [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]], where she died giving birth to [[Triclops]], the three-eyed, mutant "Son of Palpatine". Rumors of Palpatine's three-eyed son would later be used by [[Trioculus]] and the [[Central Committee of Grand Moffs]] to legitimise Trioculus' claim to the Empire.<ref name="Barely Tolerable3" />

==Personality and traits==
An [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]], Sly Moore could only see in the [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] spectrum and wore an extremely expensive [[Shadowcloak (clothing)|shadowcloak]] from her homeworld. A private person who revealed little of her torturous past, Moore's detractors in the Senate believed that she had a hidden agenda and that she was capable of driving others from office: it was whispered that she had blackmailed her predecessor [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]] into resigning, and that she concealed a stiletto-like [[Knife/Legends|knife]] known as a [[vooktar]] beneath her cloak.<ref name="Barely Tolerable3" /> Taciturn and ambitious,<ref name="DB" /> Moore was a [[Telepathy/Legends|telepath]] and was known to exude a fear-inducing stare.<ref name="H2H" />

===Romances===
====Palpatine====
Rumors persisted that Sly Moore had a [[Reproduction/Legends|sexual]] relationship with [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], and many went so far as to declare her the "Queen of the Empire."<ref name="Barely Tolerable3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sly Moore was originally created for the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> where she was portrayed by local [[Wikipedia:Australia|Australian]] disc jockey and actress [[Sandi Finlay]].<ref name="DB" /> However, she was first identified by name in the credits for the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], where Finlay reprised her role as the character.<ref name="ROTS" /> Make-up artist [[Lesley Vanderwalt]] determined Moore's skin tones and palette basing on a goth-like concept art by concept artist [[Dermot Power]].<ref name="DB" /> In one of the earlier drafts of Episode II, Moore's character was known as [[Uv Gizen]].<ref name="draftscript">{{WebCite|url=http://sfy.ru/sfy.html?script=star_wars_episode_2|text=''Attack of the Clones'' draft script|archivedate=20090228195422}}</ref>

Sly Moore's first mention as a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] was in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook|''Saga Edition Core Rulebook'']] when she was given as an example of a [[Force Adept]].
